api_doc_gaps.endpoint: (not an endpoint) analysis/modules/FIN/P3_2/ui-ux-spec-fin.md line 56 — SCR-FIN-006 UI pattern
api_doc_gaps.detail: The Entry carries a seven-field header AND a repeating seven-field line row whose accountId is a picker over the whole chart of accounts. The spec decides screen composition and is silent on where that collection and that picker live, so the decision falls to the component author. The identical silence produced a shipped defect in SCR-SEC-004 on 2026-09-19: an inline picker taller than the form it accompanied, in a second scroll container, with its own submit beside the footer Save — roles could be set and silently not saved.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — proposed amendment written in full at governance/project-artifacts/analysis-amendments-fin-drawer-pattern-2026-09-19.md. DESIGN-SPEC gap, not an api-doc gap: nothing in the published surface is wrong. Filed here because api_doc_gaps is the only channel gov.py feedback reads; the endpoint field names an artifact location. Correction rule: ui-secondary-detail-panels (stack-agnostic) / erp-drawer-zustand §10.
